scope: First substantive pass using the proven 42-municipality standard.

findings: Current municipal programme Beter benutten bestaande woningvoorraad 2025 is explicitly used for woningdelen/woningsplitsen/kavelsplitsen/tijdelijke huisvesting.
Woningsplitsing usually requires an omgevingsvergunning; urban and rural rules differ.

Urban splitting: ordinary residential dwelling, within main building, parking for cars/bicycles, Bbl requirements including escape safety, fire/smoke alarms, sound insulation, ventilation and daylight.
Rural splitting: omgevingsvergunning only; no enlargement; 300 m2 demolition credits per extra dwelling; max 4 dwellings; environmental and adjacent-parcel constraints.
Kamerverhuur: in Gemengd/Gemengd-1..14/Centrum areas it can be permit-free; elsewhere omgevingsvergunning route.
Application route for splitting/woningdelen/tijdelijke housing starts with concept request; current Omgevingsplan/Regels op de kaart determines area.
records.futureSignal: Municipality is converting existing rules into a new structured Omgevingsplan; area-by-area procedure expected from end 2026. Existing rights are intended largely to remain, but changes must be monitored.
remaining: extract exact concept-request document package/2026 fees where reliably public
direct current plan article references for key activities

findings: Current route starts with Omgevingsloket vergunningcheck.
Concept request is explicitly recommended for plans such as conversion of a shop to dwellings.
Intaketafel minimum documents: site plan, clear plan description, rationale, land ownership or owner consent.

For Omgevingsplan/quality assessment: current/new floor plans, current/new elevations, site plan, existing/environment photos, appearance details, dimensions/materials/colours; drawings to scale with dimensions.
Concept-request target response 28 working days.
2026 concept-request fee EUR 255.50; partial offset if same permit application follows within six months.
Permit decision period normally max 8 weeks, complex applications max 6 months; both can be extended once by 6 weeks.
